name: PLS Authenticator
tagline: Your codes and passwords, on this device only.
overview: PLS Authenticator keeps your two-factor sign-in codes and your passwords in one encrypted vault on your phone. No account, no cloud, no subscription, and no internet permission. Codes are free forever; the password vault is a one-time $10 unlock. You hold the only keys: your master password and a recovery key shown once.

capabilities.title: One vault, offline
capabilities.text: Your sign-in codes and your passwords live in one encrypted vault on this device. No account, no cloud, no subscription.

proofs.caption: First screen: codes free forever, passwords, offline

capabilities.title: Create your vault in five steps
capabilities.text: Pick a master password, confirm it, keep the recovery key, prove you kept it, and finish.

capabilities.title: Recovery key, shown once
capabilities.text: A recovery key is the only other way in. Save it to Downloads, as a PDF, or print it, then type a row back to prove you kept a copy.

proofs.caption: Type the row back to prove your copy
No back door: nobody can reset it for you

capabilities.title: Unlock with password or fingerprint
capabilities.text: Open the vault with your master password, or with your fingerprint once it is turned on. A wrong password is refused.

capabilities.title: Home: everything one tap away
capabilities.text: Codes, passwords, quick actions (scan, type a key, add a password, back up) and search on one screen.

proofs.caption: Home with 3 demo codes and 3 demo passwords

capabilities.title: Two-factor codes, free forever
capabilities.text: Time-based (TOTP) and counter (HOTP) codes with a countdown ring, 6 or 8 digits.

proofs.caption: Three demo accounts with live codes
On the bench: a demo account added by setup key, live code

capabilities.title: Tap to copy a code
capabilities.text: One tap copies the code so you can paste it into the sign-in page.

capabilities.title: Add by QR code or setup key
capabilities.text: Scan the QR code a site shows you, or type the setup key when there is no QR.

proofs.caption: Add an account: scan or type

capabilities.title: Edit or delete an account
capabilities.text: Rename an account or remove it, with a clear confirm before anything is deleted.

capabilities.title: Search
capabilities.text: Find any code or password by name.

capabilities.title: Password vault
capabilities.text: Save sign-ins (site, username, password, notes); passwords stay hidden until you ask.

capabilities.title: Strong password generator
capabilities.text: Make a strong password with the length and characters you choose, with a strength meter.

capabilities.title: Passwords: one $10 unlock, once
capabilities.text: Codes are free forever. Passwords are a one-time $10 unlock through Google Play, checked once and never again.

capabilities.title: Backup and restore you control
capabilities.text: Export one encrypted backup file, import it, or restore a vault on a new phone with your password or recovery key.

capabilities.title: Change the master password
capabilities.text: Change the master password any time; the vault is locked again under the new one.

capabilities.title: Auto-lock, fingerprint and privacy settings
capabilities.text: Choose when the vault locks itself, turn fingerprint unlock on or off, and hide codes until tapped.

capabilities.title: Pulse dark, Light, or follow the phone
capabilities.text: Choose the look on first start and switch any time with the eye button; text size on the Display screen.

capabilities.title: How to use this app
capabilities.text: A step-by-step manual with Show me buttons that take you to the real screen.

capabilities.title: Report a problem, your way
capabilities.text: Write what happened; your own email app opens addressed to support, and you review it before sending. Vault contents are never included.

capabilities.title: About and what's new
capabilities.text: Version, what changed, and the facts about how the vault protects you.

capabilities.title: Fill in passwords everywhere
capabilities.text: Turn on the fill-in service once; apps and sites offer your saved sign-ins, and Open site opens a site with its login ready.

capabilities.title: No internet permission
capabilities.text: The app has no internet permission at all, so nothing in the vault can leave the phone through the app.

demo.caption: 38 seconds on the test bench: choose a look, create a vault with a demo password, keep and prove the recovery key, then add a demo account by setup key and watch its code count down.

note: Pictures: the app's own screen check (build b26, v1.4.1) with demo accounts only (example.test). Demo clip and the bench code picture: Fold (open) bench profile, Android 15 emulator, a throwaway demo vault. No real accounts anywhere.
